in_marathi.name: Kishna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kishna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Krishna, which means 'all-attractive'. In Hindu mythology, Krishna is a god known for his beauty, mischievousness, and love for butter and cows. Kishna is a name for those who embody these characteristics.

in_bengali.name: Kishna
